cases.fact_text: Person A directly controls Party X through a contract giving A the power to direct X's management and policies.
Party X indirectly controls Person B through an intermediary; X owns 60% of B's voting securities.
Person C and Party X are under common control by Parent P, which indirectly controls both through contractual power to direct their management.
Person D directly controls Party X through a contract giving D the power to direct X's management and policies.
Person E directly owns 75% of Party X's voting securities.
Person F and Party X are under common control by Parent Q, which indirectly owns 80% of the voting securities of each.
Person G has no control relationship with Party X and no direct or indirect connection through intermediaries.
Person H directly controls Party X, but only through ownership of exactly 50% of X's voting securities and no power to direct management.
Person I is a foreign entity; a foreign investor owns 45% of I as permitted by local law but has no power to direct I's management; I indirectly controls Party X.
Person J directly controls Party X through power to direct management, with no intermediary.
Party X indirectly controls Person K through ownership of 49% of K's voting securities and no power to direct management.
Person L and Party X share a common parent, but the parent neither owns more than 50% nor has power to direct either; the parent indirectly owns 30% of each.
Person M directly controls Party X by some relationship, but the facts show no power to direct management, no ownership above 50%, and no foreign lower-percentage exception.
Party X indirectly controls Person N through an intermediary that has contractual power to direct N's policies.
Party X directly owns 90% of Person O's ownership interests.

dependencies: facts about direct or indirect control
facts about possession of power to direct management or policies
facts about ownership of more than fifty percent (50%) of voting securities or ownership interests
for foreign entities, applicable law maximum ownership percentage for a foreign investor and whether investor has power to direct management or policies

fields.name: relationship_to_party
fields.source_basis: controls, is controlled by or is under common control with such Party

fields.name: connection_type
fields.source_basis: directly or indirectly, through one (1) or more intermediaries

fields.name: control_basis
fields.source_basis: possession, directly or indirectly, of the power to direct the management or policies of a Person ... or ... ownership ... of more than fifty percent (50%) ... foreign investor may be less than fifty percent (50%) ... provided that such foreign investor has the power to direct the management or policies

program.rule_summary: A Person is an Affiliate of a Party if the Person controls, is controlled by, or is under common control with the Party, directly or indirectly through intermediaries, and that control is based on power to direct management or policies, ownership of more than 50% of voting securities or ownership interests, or a foreign lower-percentage exception where the foreign investor has power to direct management or policies.

fields.name: entity_name
fields.source_basis: "PARTY" shall mean each of T&L and Igene

original_program.rule_summary: An entity is a PARTY if and only if entity_name is exactly T&L or exactly Igene.

issues: The source defines PARTY by identity: each of T&L and Igene. It does not impose an exact-string, capitalization-sensitive entity_name matching rule.

The predicate unsupportedly treats spelling, capitalization, punctuation, and corporate-suffix variants as necessarily distinct non-PARTY entities. The source provides no alias, legal-name, or identity-resolution rule establishing those exclusions.
Several exclusion cases state only that a label is not an exact textual match; that does not establish that the underlying entity is not T&L or Igene under the contractual definition.
Use an entity-identity field or an explicitly sourced canonical-name/alias rule rather than exact equality on an entity_name label.

program.source_quote: 1.28. "PARTY" shall mean each of T&L and Igene, and "PARTIES" shall mean both T&L and Igene.
